title: PRDCritique
description: Structured output contract for PRD-Critic. Shared by the local live runner (passed as output_config.format.schema) and the schema fixture test (tools/prd-critic/local/schema.test.mjs), which validates the committed canned-demo output against this file.

overall_summary.description: 2-4 sentence summary of the PRD's overall readiness to build.

score.description: 1 = missing/unusable, 3 = present but underspecified, 5 = clear and complete

rationale.description: 1-3 sentences explaining the score, specific to this PRD.

supporting_quote.description: A short verbatim quote from the PRD backing the rationale, or null if the gap is an absence (nothing to quote).

top_risks.description: The risks most likely to cause a costly rebuild or a production incident if unaddressed, ranked highest-first.

missing_sections.description: Sections/considerations absent from the PRD entirely, not just weakly written.
